purpose: Multi-value dropdown with checkbox options, optional filtering, and count-summary trigger text.
useWhen: Selecting multiple values from a fixed option list while preserving compact form layout.
Showing many options in an anchored picker instead of a permanently-expanded checkbox group.

avoidWhen.reason: Selecting a single value from a short fixed list — use select instead.
Moving items between available/selected panes — use transfer-list instead.
